issues.evidence: Real browser malformed local portfolio returns empty; saving a valid Bob session overwrites recoverable Alice raw bytes. Emergency backup preserves them before save but loses them afterward. Actual pagehide, hidden visibilitychange and explicit sync overwrite the raw portfolio with {} even without saving a new essay; three real-browser paths reproduced.
issues.validation: Coordinator full production diff, strict-read boundaries and browser regression source read; independently reran corrupted-storage browser suite, all passed.

issues.title: Missing scores are described as poor performance
issues.evidence: Actual-source injected response with one Missing handwriting criterion and explicit valid 8/10 fallback generates lowest-band criticism for the missing criterion, because Number(null) is 0. Actual-source getAuditScoreBandLabel(null/empty/whitespace) returns worst 4–5 band although unknown input should be unscored; used by audit display and validation.

issues.title: Student portfolio HTML export executes untrusted score and photo markup
issues.evidence: Actual createSingleStudentArchiveZip accepts portfolio JSON whose overall contains image markup and photo dataUrl breaks an attribute; opening its generated HTML executes two harmless onerror markers. Browser network fully intercepted. Zero scanner security findings did not detect this export boundary defect. Actual reassessment also executes accepted photo dataUrl attribute markup in unsanitized updateSelectedImagePreview.

issues.title: Remove unshipped helper copies and unused bundled helper islands
issues.evidence: 14 explicit source paths unreachable from index/runtime loading, two explicitly dual-tested fixtures; 84 baseline findings on helper copies and six in unused bundled helper island. issues.title: Delayed crop callback changes another student/photo after cancellation
issues.evidence: Real browser actual applyCrop; held native image load, cancel, select Bob and replace image, then release callback. Bob overwritten with Alice crop; original Alice untouched. Review open/reset crop callbacks and invalidation/owner handling.
issues.validation: Full production and regression source read, independent native Edge38/38. Uploaded-photo reference persistence is separate PHOTO-002, not claimed fixed.

issues.title: Same-image merge overwrites newer photo reference with older metadata
issues.evidence: Actual sync both local-newer and cloud-newer preserve newer originalText but replace same imageId driveFileId with older file. Root secondary field overlay in mergeSessionImageRefs; inspect missing media references and all callers, preserve distinct-image union.

issues.title: Untrusted photo identity key mutates Object.prototype during sync
issues.evidence: Actual sync with synthetic imageId __proto__ copies harmless marker to Object.prototype through same-image byKey dictionary. Related SYNC-003 helper; use safe dictionary identity handling and inspect analogous merged/byKey maps without removing valid images.

issues.title: In-flight grade change mixes original assessment metadata with current scoring policy
issues.evidence: Real browser Grade12 analysis, paused first AI request, switch visible grade to4. Original snapshot remains Grade12 while actual adjustment uses4;150 words/330 target/base8 returns4 versus expected5. Inspect all mutable assessment settings read after await; retain coherent snapshot or invalidate changed context, preserve valid pending work.

issues.title: Failed preference save is acknowledged and schedules sync
issues.evidence: A failed wft_settings write returns targetWordCount 300 while disk remains 200, advances the settings counter and schedules sync; no exception reaches the caller.
issues.scope: Ordinary preference saving outside the repaired student operations, when no recovery buffer is active.

issues.title: Unused archive-removal helper writes a mismatched legacy session marker
issues.evidence: With shipped student-ID mapping disabled, this auxiliary helper writes session::archive-a while the legacy portfolio filter looks for session:alice:archive-a. Local removal succeeds but the old cloud session remains visible to applyDeletionsToPortfolio.
issues.scope: The shipped auxiliary helper has no shipped caller; the current school-year archive UI uses clearCurrentClassAfterSuccessfulArchive instead.

issues.title: Portfolio summary reads wrong score field and acknowledges stale or offline saves
issues.evidence: Actual-browser pinned shipped source at 9c26ded: valid overall80 indexed average0; delayed upload snapshot count1, concurrent save count2, then dirty flag false and retry false. Offline direct index sync reports true and clears dirty despite zero upload calls. Derived summary defect; no primary essay loss reproduced.

issues.title: OAuth redirect proceeds after failing to preserve unsaved writing
issues.evidence: Actual shipped requestDriveAccess and saveWftOAuthDraftBeforeRedirect at pinned9c, synthetic VM navigation sink: rejected local draft write is swallowed; redirect URL assigned while writing exists only in departing document. No real auth requests or navigation.

issues.title: Sign-out reports success while a retained session token can restore sign-in
issues.evidence: Actual shipped handleGoogleSignOut, clearWftTokenSession and restoreWftTokenSession at pinned9c: synthetic failed token removal and failed network revocation, UI reports Signed out; subsequent normal token restore returns true and marks signedIn. No real token/network.

issues.title: Correction comparison blocks the UI with a full repeated token matrix
issues.evidence: Actual browser pinned9c renderCorrected, one appended word: 500tokens53ms,1000tokens165ms,2000tokens611ms,4000tokens1397ms synchronously. Full markChangedTokens/getDiffOperations/buildLcsMatrix and callers read: full token-pair matrix allocation plus normalization inside every cell dominates; also used by grammar analysis. No service/network calls. Timings are this machine, not universal thresholds.

issues.title: Missing API key triggers futile fallback retries and delayed error
issues.evidence: Actual requestOpenRouterWithFallback at pinned9c with empty API_KEY and text-wrapper maxRetriesPerModel1: ten payload attempts, zero fetches, nine backoff sleeps totaling15.6seconds before showing missing-key error. Synthetic VM timers/sleeps; no paid AI call. Local input validation is incorrectly retried as a transient network failure.

issues.title: Rename confirmation writes a stale portfolio and loses intervening saved writing
issues.evidence: Pinned real-browser renameStudent: confirmation held, second Alice essay saved via actual saveStudentSession, then confirmation released. Portfolio had2 entries before, Alicia has only first afterward, UI reports rename success. Root portfolio snapshot captured before await confirmation. Actual app functions, blocked services, synthetic records.

issues.title: Photo sync writes a stale portfolio snapshot and loses newer saved writing
issues.evidence: Actual browser at original9c and repaired882: syncPendingPortfolioMedia holds photo upload, second essay saved via actual saveStudentSession, photo callback released, sync reports no error but captured portfolio overwrites second essay. Valid portfolio remains readable; strict corruption guard is correctly outside this separate snapshot race. Synthetic photo/file IDs and blocked services.

issues.title: Detailed assessment terminator creates empty categories and suppresses valid scores
issues.evidence: Actual source parseDetailedAssessment at pinned882: unbolded valid fallback labels yield Ideas8/Grammar7 without Grow Goal header; adding ## Grow Goal Selection yields null ghost category entries, suppressing valid fallback and later quick-score inheritance. Root nextLabelRegex alternation lacks grouping. Child notice/guide parsing stubbed only; real category regex/score/fallback parsing used.

issues.title: Notebook punctuation and spelling changes receive incorrect teaching labels
issues.evidence: Actual-source inferConventionSkill labels punctuation-only revision Checking Conventions and word spelling replacement Checking Punctuation. All two shipped category-generator callers read; condition compares punctuation-stripped text with inverted meaning. work/reproduce-notebook-guide.cjs pins882 and reproduces both.

issues.title: Notebook paragraph revisions lose their separation before display
issues.evidence: Actual-source candidate with required double newline accepted but normalization deletes paragraph separation; paragraph-only change rejected as non-concrete. Renderer independently strips breaks even from raw candidate. work/reproduce-notebook-guide.cjs uses actual normalization, grounding, category, revision and render functions; render-options/HTML escaping and unreachable fallback-label adapters stubbed.

issues.title: Corrupt deletion history is overwritten as empty
issues.evidence: Pinned882 actual-source getDeletionsData returns empty markers for unreadable existing deletion bytes; actual recordStudentDeletion then overwrites those bytes with only Bob deletion and marks/schedules success. work/reproduce-deletion-integrity.cjs reproduces lost original bytes with real read/normalize/save/record functions and synthetic storage.

issues.title: Enabled experimental deletion compaction recurses indefinitely
issues.evidence: Complete compactDeletions calls normalizeDeletionsData, which unconditionally calls compactDeletions. With WFT_TOMBSTONE_COMPACTION_V1 true actual-source normalization throws RangeError, verified in work/reproduce-deletion-integrity.cjs. Flag defaults false, so current default path does not recurse.

issues.title: Separate notebook action lines are collapsed into one checklist item
